info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Underwritings-v5-spec
info.description: The List Mortgage Loan Underwriting API provides access to detailed underwriting information for mortgage loans. This endpoint enables mortgage professionals and financial institutions to retrieve comprehensive underwriting data, enhancing decision-making processes. Typical use cases include loan assessments and risk evaluations, ensuring that users have accurate and relevant information at their fingertips. This API streamlines the flow of underwriting insights and supports efficient mortgage loan processing.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information regarding the loan underwriting process, including status, requirements, and available options. Use this to gain insights into underwriting decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the underwriting process for a loan. It requires the necessary parameters that detail the loan specifics and borrower information, enabling the underwriting service to evaluate the loan application effectively.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the loans underwriting service. It is a string type that typically contains a JSON formatted string representing the request parameters.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsResponse_2.title: Underwriting Response

status.description: Indicates whether the underwriting operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the loan application.

state.description: Current state of the loan application.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the underwriting operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the underwriting operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the underwriting process.

ListMortgageLoansUnderwritingsResponse_2.description: Schema representing the response structure for the underwriting operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was conducted automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the audit information for an underwriting operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
